note: The maintainer's bench report on one unit of each model with no person or load attached; not a certification. The checks ran on the preceding CI build of this source, which differs from these images only in three visual changes to the built-in page: how the address line wraps, a softer background glow and the wording of one notice. Timer logic is unchanged.

rest_sse.summary: 29 REST/SSE checks and the live-update stream limit passed. Legacy pause and lock routes are refused when switched off; requests under a public hostname are refused.

signed_http_ota.summary: Installed over local HTTP as a signed release after a physical arm; a tampered signature and a changed version were refused.

mixed_transport_soak.summary: Two hours of mixed load (two live-update streams, continuous requests, Wi-Fi scans): 20,988 requests with no failures or timeouts. The longest main-loop pause was 0.9 s, at start-up.

physical_safety.summary: The emergency input released a running session and a session with locked controls, and refused a new start while held. Restarted with the input held, the timer booted released and refused to start until it was let go.

network_recovery.summary: Access-point onboarding, bad credentials, lost-router recovery and the ten-second settings reset not yet checked on this image.
